evidence.notes: LeadConvertResult exposes the shared Database result error list.
Person Account conversion is not modeled; the DTO accessor returns null.
MergeResult exposes the local Database result error list.
DuplicateError exposes DTO accessors without adding duplicate-rule execution.

source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseSmallResultDtosTest { @isTest static void smallResultDtoAccessorsStayExplicit() { Database.LeadConvertResult lead = new Database.LeadConvertResult(); System.assertEquals(0, lead.getErrors().size()); System.assertEquals(null, lead.getRelatedPersonAccountId()); Account master = new Account(Name = 'Master'); insert master; Account duplicate = new Account(Name = 'Duplicate'); insert duplicate; Database.MergeResult merged = Database.merge(master, duplicate, false); System.assert(merged.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(0, merged.getErrors().size()); Database.DuplicateError duplicateError = new Database.DuplicateError(); System.assertNotEquals(null, duplicateError.getDuplicateResult()); System.assertEquals(0, duplicateError.getFields().size()); System.assertEquals(null, duplicateError.getMessage()); System.assertEquals(null, duplicateError.getStatusCode()); } }
